caption: The video showcases a white round plate filled with a smooth, pale-green creamy dessert resting centered on a warm wooden tabletop. The cream spreads to a flat, glossy surface, and at its middle sits a raised, dome-shaped mound coated in the same green sauce, ringed by several translucent fruit pieces, including light-green and yellowish chunks plus one rounded pale piece set toward the front. A few tiny bubbles and faint purple flecks are suspended throughout the cream, while a soft highlight glints off the mound's rounded top under the overhead light. The plate rim, the central mound, each fruit piece, and the wood-grain background keep a consistent position and appearance. No clear object movement, deformation, expansion, or camera translation is apparent, so the plated dessert reads as a single composed still arrangement of food and dishware, with no action emerging or resolving.
